classification_policy: Official website or authoritative regulator evidence only; unresolved records are manual_review.

records.name: National Institute of Financial Management (NIFM)
records.statutory_basis: Autonomous institution of the Ministry of Finance, Government of India
records.evidence: The Government of India document identifies NIFM as an autonomous institution of the Ministry of Finance, Government of India, at Faridabad. The institute's official education offering includes postgraduate financial-management programmes, so it admits students.
records.notes: Classified as a central-government institute, not a university. Family row is not present in the current families table.

records.name: Institute of Financial Management and Research (IFMR)
records.statutory_basis: Graduate School of Business of Krea University; private university constituent school
records.evidence: IFMR's official website describes IFMR Graduate School of Business as part of Krea University and lists BBA, integrated MBA, MBA, MSc Finance, PhD and executive programmes with admissions. Krea is a private university, so this current IFMR record belongs to the private-university constituent group.
records.notes: The legacy name predates the Krea integration; keep the institute record but add a parent-institute relationship to Krea University when available.

records.name: CFA Institute (India Chapter)
records.statutory_basis: International professional association and owner of the CFA Program and CFA charter
records.evidence: CFA Institute's official charter page states that it administers the three-level CFA Program and awards the CFA charter after examinations, qualifying work experience and membership. This is a professional-route owner, not a university or college.
records.notes: The India Chapter is a local society/community record under the global CFA Institute; ownership is not applicable for G10a.

records.name: Srishti Manipal Institute of Art Design and Technology
records.statutory_basis: Constituent/off-campus branch of Manipal Academy of Higher Education, an institution deemed to be a university under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956
records.evidence: The official Srishti Manipal site states that the institute is part of MAHE's Bengaluru off-campus/branch campus and lists B.Voc, B.Des/BFA, PG Diploma, M.Des and M.A. programmes. MAHE is a deemed-to-be university, so the constituent institute maps to G5.
records.notes: Family row is not present in the current families table; leave family_slug null until the canonical MAHE/Srishti family mapping is added.

records.name: CEPT University
records.statutory_basis: CEPT University Act, 2005 (Gujarat); UGC Section 2(f) recognition
records.evidence: CEPT's official About page says it was incorporated as a university by the Government of Gujarat in 2005 and recognized by UGC under Section 2(f) in 2007. Its official home page identifies it as a private university and lists undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes.
records.notes: Family row is not present in the current families table; leave family_slug null until the canonical CEPT family is added.

records.name: Sir JJ College of Architecture
records.statutory_basis: Constituent architecture school of Sir J.J. School of Art, Architecture and Design, declared deemed-to-be university under the de-novo category
records.evidence: The current official Sir J.J. university site identifies the School of Art, Architecture and Design as a deemed-to-be university under the de-novo category and lists B.Arch and M.Arch admissions. The legacy College of Architecture record is therefore classified under the current deemed-university parent.
records.notes: This record likely needs a parent_institute_id linking it to the Sir J.J. School of Art, Architecture and Design row when that parent is loaded.

records.name: Lovely Professional University
records.statutory_basis: Lovely Professional University Act, 2005 (Punjab); UGC-recognized private university
records.evidence: LPU's official site identifies Lovely Professional University as a private university in Punjab and provides admissions across undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes.
records.notes: Family row is not present in the current families table; leave family_slug null until the canonical LPU family is added.

records.name: MAEER MIT Institute of Design
records.statutory_basis: Constituent institute of MIT Art, Design and Technology University, Pune
regulators: MIT Art, Design and Technology University
records.evidence: The official MIT ADT University programmes page lists MIT Institute of Design programmes including B.Des, M.Des and PG Diploma offerings. It is a constituent institute of the private MIT Art, Design and Technology University.
records.notes: Family row is not present in the current families table; leave family_slug null until the canonical MIT ADT family is added.

records.name: JJ School of Art Mumbai
records.statutory_basis: Sir J.J. School of Art, Architecture and Design declared deemed-to-be university under the de-novo category
records.evidence: The current official Sir J.J. site identifies Sir J.J. School of Art, Architecture and Design as a deemed-to-be university under the de-novo category and lists degree admissions including applied art and architecture programmes.
records.notes: The legacy school record should eventually be linked as a child/constituent record of the current Sir J.J. deemed university.

records.name: College of Architecture Trivandrum
records.statutory_basis: Privately owned, stand-alone self-financing institute affiliated to APJ Abdul Kalam Technological University; architecture programme approved by the Council of Architecture
records.evidence: The official CAT About page explicitly calls the institute privately owned and stand-alone, says it is self-financing, confirms B.Arch/B.Des/BMS programmes, and identifies affiliation to APJ Abdul Kalam Technological University with COA/AICTE approval.
records.notes: G8 is appropriate because this is a private affiliated standalone college, not a private university. Family row is not present in the current families table.
